---
title: John Dory Risotto
id: MAR-0105
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 55
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 1 kg John Dory fish, ready for cooking
- 280 g riso fino rice
- 1 l court-bouillon
- 10 g butter
- 30 g sour butter
## Method
1. Place the fish in the cooking container, cover it with the court-bouillon and cook for about 20 minutes.
2. Drain and fillet it.
3. In a saucepan, melt the butter and toast the rice for a minute.
4. Pour the boiling broth one ladle at a time, so that the liquid just covers the surface of the rice, and cook until done.
5. Turn off the heat and stir in the sour butter.
6. Divide the risotto among plates, top with the fish and serve.
